review_execution.method: read-only source, manifest, historical JSON metadata, installed public API source, and SHA256 review

component_reported_isolated_tests.scope: isolated contracts only; no actual FE restoration, factors, PDE or independent numeric checker qualification

reviewed_contracts.name: native and auxiliary coordinates
reviewed_contracts.detail: Full native FE vectors retain 15872 independent rows and all 8640 interiors. Entity R and inverse transformations are distinct from dual R^H. The full layout uses only entity blocks and a 4x4 DFT. Local dual load is P_b^H f; local port load is g_sector/sqrt2; recovered global alpha is beta/sqrt2. Both local branches and all 532 original ports survive exactly once.

reviewed_contracts.name: augmentation signs and complete recovery
reviewed_contracts.detail: Inherited reduce_rhs and recover_storage APIs receive complete 8940 local storage, original independent rows, rhs_is_mpc_dual=True and expand_trace=False. They retain 4320 interiors, nonzero interior C/D support and dense Hhat. Stored D is copied without a second conjugation. Original nonzero-g residual uses f-C H^-1g, port residual Du-Halpha+g, and e_native=e_FE-C H^-1e_port.

reviewed_contracts.name: snapshot and new recovery provenance
reviewed_contracts.detail: Pinned complete packet inventories, exact metadata and public carrier construction are required. Actual finalized MPC, both dofmaps, geometry/facets/materials, orientation, Basix, config and ABI must match. Historical primary binary/generated-C files are rehashed before restoration and remain historical-only. New volume/recovery uses existing constructors. Exact local row and all 20 raw/oriented tensor hashes plus cache policy are checked before factors; old and new compiler signatures are retained separately.

reviewed_contracts.name: factor ownership, integer admission and resources
reviewed_contracts.detail: All four freshly compared CSR inputs are hash-bound before public SuperLU calls. Bounded dimensions and integer checks precede conversion. Four factors remain simultaneously retained; no L/U statistics copies occur. Current measured RSS includes previous factors, local caches and resident CSR; declared additional workspace, remaining (4-j)*128 MiB factor allowance and 128 MiB reserve are added. Unknown fill remains unknown. Constructor, incident-JIT and FGMRES vector admissions are explicit. The watchdog remains the actual memory/time/swap authority.

reviewed_contracts.name: ownership and failure evidence
reviewed_contracts.detail: Borrowed volume Vec data is consumed or copied before reapply and never destroyed by wrappers. Condensed objects own their action/system, physical bundles own their actions, and the notch action borrows original DtN. Acquired objects have finally cleanup and partial factor failures clear retained factors. Factor-created count/hash evidence is emitted immediately after retention, before diagnostic saves. Failed, controlled-stop and supervision failures cannot become PASS.

reviewed_contracts.name: prefactor and original notch scope
reviewed_contracts.detail: Default CLI is plan-only. External staging cannot execute numeric dispatch. Prefactor returns before q-factor or solve construction and rejects factor callbacks, allowance and solved-source payloads. Solve uses all four unchanged original full FE loads, four within-q nonzero-port controls, and the genuine exactly-two-cell notch with inherited full-size right FGMRES/restart 32/max 128. Final A1 auxiliary ports are recomputed from the final field.

reviewed_contracts.name: independent evidence nonvacuity
reviewed_contracts.detail: Checker requires full array/source/ABI/provenance/receipt inventories; independently checks all CSR entries, factor residual/repeat/linearity, native vectors, original C/D/H, incident identities, scales, MPC recovery and all 532 plane/global outputs. Global values are converted through the existing representability-safe gauge API and tied per mode to current fields and immutable p4 controls. Exact zero operation scales fail on nonzero errors. Comparison/recovery event payloads bind exactly to report receipts before factor admission. Missing or nonfinite outputs cannot qualify.
